;Business and economy
*[[Type 055 destroyer]]
**[[China]]'s state-run ''[[Global Times]]'' newspaper reports the launching of the first [[Type 055 destroyer]], a 10,000-ton "new generation" warship, at the [[Jiangnan Shipyard]] in [[Shanghai]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-defense-destroyer-idUSKBN19J0GX (Reuters)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*Aftermath of the [[Hillsborough disaster]]
**Six people are charged with various offences including [[manslaughter|manslaughter by gross negligence]] following the [[Hillsborough disaster]] in 1989. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-40419819 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[China–North Korea relations]]
**Fearing lack of payment, [[China National Petroleum Corporation]] stops selling oil to [[North Korea]]. [http://www.ibtimes.com/china-suspends-fuel-sales-north-korea-amid-tense-times-2558704 (''International Business Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Nepalese local elections, 2017]]
**Nepalis vote in the second round of local elections, a major step in the near decade-long transition from [[Kingdom of Nepal|monarchy]] to democratic government. The first round was held on May 14, and the final round is scheduled for September 18, after the [[Wet season|monsoon season]]. Parliamentary elections are expected later this year. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nepal-election-idUSKBN19J0DO (Reuters)]
*[[2017 Venezuelan constitutional crisis]]
**The [[Supreme Tribunal of Justice (Venezuela)|Supreme Court]] of [[Venezuela]] bars [[Luisa Ortega Díaz]], the chief prosecutor and outspoken critic of president [[Nicolás Maduro]],  from leaving the country and freezes her assets. [https://sputniknews.com/latam/201706291055065824-venezuela-bans-chief-prosecutor/ (Sputnik)]

;Sports
* [[NCAA Division I conference realignment]]
** The [[Horizon League]] announces that [[IUPUI Jaguars|IUPUI]] (full name [[Indiana University – Purdue University Indianapolis]]) will join the conference on July 1. The Jaguars will move from the [[Summit League]] to replace [[Valparaiso Crusaders|Valparaiso University]], moving from the Horizon to the [[Missouri Valley Conference]] on the same date. [http://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/the-horizon-league-picks-iupui-to-replace-valpo-and-might-add-more-teams-in-future/ (CBS Sports)]
